name: Aawaas Sahayata
benefit: The scheme offers housing assistance to tribal students pursuing higher education outside their hometowns where hostels are unavailable.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should have passed 12th grade from a Government or Non-Government college. 1. The student should be enrolled in a Graduate or Graduate Diploma course. 1. The student should be regularly admitted to a Technical or Paramedical course. 1. The student should not have secured admission to a Government hostel. 1. The student should be a tribal student pursuing higher education outside their hometown.
